_comment: The series of the pivotal-history domain, the domain's twin of history/series.json. A dossier's `series` is one of these ids. Membership of a series is a claim like any other: established from fetched sources and re-checked by a reader whose job is to refute it (scout.md §3).

series.title: Pivotal Histories
series.membership: One episode (a battle, a siege, a crossing, a campaign season, a codebreak) whose outcome the sources tie to a tactical, scientific, technical or logistic edge, and whose outcome changed what came after.
scoutHints: Start from sources.json, best licence first: old translations of the participants and chroniclers, government histories, then the encyclopedias for leads.
The participant's own account is the prize: a commander's commentary, a dispatch, a ship's log, an interview. It earns the immersive passages (voice.md §2).
Prefer an episode the sources document in days or hours over one they sum up in a sentence.
Romans and Mongols are the author's first examples; the engine is not limited to them.
sensitivity: voice.md §5: the dead are people; peoples by their own names; living nations treated as living communities.
A partisan source's numbers are attributed, never adopted (voice.md §4).
No glorifying of a conqueror or a weapon: the edge is explained, never cheered.

book._comment: The series as one book (tools/series_book.py), the author's ask of 2026-10-18: 'this was a great first part for this book, we should keep going so we can eventually make a complete book'. Episodes run in the order they happened (each dossier's `when`); a part with no story yet is not shown. The part titles are editorial apparatus, the author's to change. No places map: book_map draws on the Seattle guide's basemap (placesMap false). Nothing is published without the author.
book.title: Pivotal Histories
book.subtitle: Battles, sieges and breakthroughs decided by an edge
book.intro: Moments when a tactic, a machine, a piece of science or a line of supply decided what happened next, in the order they happened. Each is told from the record, its sources cited paragraph by paragraph, and where a participant left an account you are placed, by declaration, where they stood.
